headline: Southern (SO) Stock Stays Cheap On Earnings While Broader Checks Look Expensive
summary: Southern stock has delivered a 68.4% return over the past five years, yet its low value score suggests the current price of US$92.69 does not screen as an obvious bargain on broader checks. Over the last five years, Southern has returned 68.4%, which puts recent short term share price softness in the context of a strong longer run for investors.
